notes: Signal extraction: take `bits` bits from the big-endian integer starting at `byte`, after shifting right by `shift`.
value = raw * scale + offset. confidence: confirmed | likely | guess. `values` maps a raw value to a label (states, gears).
Most 10/20 ms messages end with: byte[-2] low nibble = rolling counter (0-15), byte[-1] = CRC-8 SAE J1850 (poly 0x1D, init 0xFF, xorout 0xFF) of all previous bytes.

I checked every signal against the recordings in captures/ and the markers I wrote while recording (SPEED xx MPH, GEAR n, RPM xxxx, E-BRAKE ENGAGE...), and since 2026-11-17 against values I asked the engine computer for while driving. 'confirmed' = matches markers or OBD values across several sessions.

2026-11-17 drive (boost, pedal, speed to 77 mph, steering, turn signals): all frames captured, OBD PIDs + UDS DIDs 195A/192D/1935/1302 asked ~20x/s for reference. UDS 22 192D = gear as a plain number.

cluster.gear_note: ZF 8HP. Only used when no 'gear' signal is decoded. Measured RPM/mph in 3rd..8th: 89, 72, 55, 42, 34, 27 (captures/old_firmware).

pedal.note: Pedal sensor % (0x412 b3) at rest / floored / pushed through the kickdown switch, from the 2026-11-17 drive

modules.18DA40F1: Body computer (BCM)? - most network / body codes land here

rejected: 0FA b4 as speed (body counter, ~6 mph error) - use 101
100 b2-b3 as speed or coolant (wheel dynamics ticks)
1F7 b5 as coolant, 104 b7 / 0FA b5 as oil temp, 0FB b1 / 192 as outside temp
0FC b0 high nibble as engaged gear while moving (RPM mux) - use 2EF
0FB b3 x0.1 as boost psi (22 psi with engine off; low nibble always 4/C, so not a byte-aligned signal)
0FB b2-b3 as boost (revving-only lead; on a drive 0x2EF b3 matches the boost sensor, r 0.999)

signals.name: Engine RPM
signals.note: (b0*256 + (b1&0xFC))/4. Matches the RPM 1000/2000/3000 markers in manual_drive. ~800 idle.

signals.name: Vehicle speed
signals.note: 13-bit km/h x16 (b0 bits 1-0, b1, b2 bits 7-5). True speed: the cluster shows ~3% more (SPEED 45 MPH marker = 43.7 here). km/h = raw/16. Checked against OBD PID 0D on a drive to 77 mph: median error 0.08 mph.

signals.name: Speedometer (as on dash)
signals.note: Same field x1.025 + 0.3 mph: an earlier cluster calibration. Matches the SPEED xx MPH markers within ~1 mph.

signals.name: Engaged gear
signals.note: ZF 8HP. Checked with RPM/mph per code across all drives: 3=89, 4=72, 5=55, 6=42, 8=34 (7th), 9=27 (8th) - matches the 8HP ratios. GEAR 3-6 markers match.

signals.name: Target gear
signals.note: Low nibble. Shows the next gear while a shift is prepared (0x34 = in 3rd, going to 4th), F = no shift pending.

signals.name: Boost
signals.note: Gauge boost, 15 mbar per step (b3 + top bit of b4). Matches the boost sensor (UDS 18DA10F1 22 195A minus baro) with r 0.999, median error 5 mbar, up to 26 psi on the 2026-11-17 drive. Reads 0 under vacuum.

signals.name: Gearbox input (turbine) speed
signals.note: Scale 0.5: with the converter locked in every gear 3-8 it equals engine RPM (ratio 1.00 over all drives). Lower than RPM in Park / pulling away = converter slip.

signals.name: Transmission fluid temp?
signals.note: BACCAble formula ((b2&1)<<5 | b3>>3). Only moves 28->33 while coolant goes 64->100, so the scale/offset is probably wrong.

signals.name: Coolant temp
signals.note: b0 - 40. Cold start 64 C -> 100 C after the warm-up drive; 'operating temp' marker at ~90+.

signals.name: Engine load (2ED)
signals.note: ~5% idle, 0 on lift-off (fuel cut), 50-80% on throttle stabs. Not pedal position.

signals.name: Engine load
signals.note: Same as OBD PID 04 (calculated load): r = 0.998, scale 100/255. Found 2026-11-16 with canscope obdref while revving.

signals.name: Accelerator pedal
signals.note: Same as OBD PID 49 (pedal sensor D), r 0.999. ~20% = released, ~84% = floored, ~90% = pushed through the kickdown switch.

signals.name: Oil temp
signals.note: ((b2&0x3F)<<2 | b3>>6) - 40. Rises 57 -> 93 C during manual_drive, lagging coolant as oil should. Matches the engine computer's oil temp (UDS 22 1302) within ~2 C on the 2026-11-17 drive (0x4B2 is sent ~1/s, so it lags).

signals.name: Outside temp
signals.note: ((b1&3)<<7 | b2>>1) - 142. Reads 67-68 F in the temps session (markers: 68 OUTSIDE, 67 OUTSIDE).

signals.name: Brake pedal
signals.note: b0 0x80 = released, 0x8C = pressed (BRAKE ON marker). b0 bit 7 drops to 0 (0x20) when the car is off.

signals.name: Parking brake
signals.note: b0 bit 3. b0 0x28 = applied, 0x20 = released (engine on), 0x08 = applied with car off. Matches the E-BRAKE ENGAGE/RELEASE markers in 3 sessions (allow ~2 s for the motor).

messages.name: Wheel motion
messages.note: b0-b5 all zero = standing still. b5 follows vehicle speed 1:1 in km/h (r 1.000) - probably a wheel speed.

messages.name: Climate control
messages.note: Found 2026-11-16 in the temps/HVAC session. Changes exactly with the HVAC and fan markers. Setpoint itself not found yet (probably on the body bus, not OBD).

signals.name: Climate: manual fan (AUTO off)
signals.note: Flips to 1 exactly when the fan was set by hand ('will exit the AUTO function' marker).

signals.name: Climate: blower command
signals.note: Inverse of fan speed in manual mode: 0xB1 lowest notch ... 0x16 full speed. Off = 0x3C.

signals.name: Climate: mix / outlet target
signals.note: Flat while set 61-67 F, then climbs steadily 0x2C -> 0xCC (byte 4) as the setpoint goes 68 -> 84 F.

signals.name: 41E word 0 (rises after engine start)
signals.note: Jumps when engine starts, then creeps up slowly. b1/b3 also jump at every window up/down press (motor current), so probably battery voltage/current (IBS).

messages.name: VIN
messages.note: byte0 = part index 0..2, bytes1-7 = ASCII. Parts 0+1+2 = 17-char VIN.

messages.name: Body (windows / doors)
messages.note: Bursts on window/door events (Driver_door_panel_for_windows session). Siblings 416/41A/41E.

messages.name: Warnings / faults
messages.note: b3-b4 count up while cluster warnings are active.

messages.name: Turbo / AWD
messages.note: AWD / turbo related. The b2-b3 'boost target' lead from revving in Park did not hold up on the drive - real boost is in 0x2EF.

signals.name: Steering angle
signals.note: raw 7200 = straight, full left 11244 (+404 deg), full right 3163 (-404 deg): about 2.25 turns lock to lock. Left positive. From one full-lock test, parked, 2026-11-17.

signals.name: Steering speed?
signals.note: Low 12 bits of b2-b3 sit at 2000 with the wheel still and move only while it turns.

messages.name: Wheel speeds?
messages.note: b0-b3 very dynamic when rolling; not vehicle speed (use 101).

messages.name: Stability / steering?
messages.note: Stability. b3-b4 (12 bits) sit at 0x800 when parked and move only when driving - yaw rate or lateral acceleration candidate.

signals.name: Intake air temp
signals.note: Equals the engine computer's intake air value (UDS 22 1935) one-to-one, r 0.998. The -40 offset is the usual formula for that value (read 30-41 C on a 10 C night).

signals.name: Throttle plate
signals.note: Follows OBD PID 11 (absolute throttle position, ~11% closed) with r 0.991.

signals.name: Left turn signal
signals.note: Blinks with the left signal. It blinked twice as fast (0.17 s) because the front-left bulb was out - bulb-out hyper-flash.

signals.name: Right turn signal
signals.note: Blinks with the right signal (0.34 s, normal rate).

signals.name: Brake pressure
signals.note: 0 with the foot off, 60-70 holding the car still, up to ~52 during a firm stop on the 2026-11-17 drive. Behaves like master-cylinder pressure; 'bar' is assumed, not proven.

signals.name: Brake pedal travel?
signals.note: b0 rests at 16 with the pedal released and goes to ~36 when pressed (offset removed). b1 top bits are a 2-bit counter.
